text:
amy: Heads-up – tiny-batch quant canary (slice t-22) showing 3.2% eviction rate spike since 02:10 UTC. I throttled the slice to 10% but want to pause night rollover until we confirm.
chris: Seen. Can you post the slice id and the deploybot pin state? Also any linked perf graphs?
sandeep: linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/quant-evictions?slice=t-22 low-res heatmap looks like kv-cache churn.
amy: slice=t-22, deploybot shows: pinned -> runtime-quant:v5.2.1 (ttl 4h). Graph: spikes align with the v5.2.1 matmul kernel rollout at 02:00 UTC.
deploybot: @amy noted. To pause rollouts for slice t-22 run: `deploybot pin --slice t-22 --reason "eviction-spike-investigation" --until 2026-03-21T08:00Z`
chris: I'd prefer unwind (reduce traffic) + pin to keep stable until we get a tinyfix. Amy, can you run an unwind to 0% and then pin? If we pin while traffic still routing it might keep failing.
amy: doing unwind now -> `deploybot traffic-shift --slice t-22 --pct 0 --method gradual --ttl 10m`
ops-bot: Traffic shift accepted. Estimated completion 02:25 UTC.
amy: unwind completed at 02:24 UTC. Now pinning.
deploybot: Pin created: runtime-quant:v5.2.1 pinned for slice t-22 until 2026-03-21T08:00Z by amy. (pin_id: p-98342)
luis: Good. Next: release notes. We need to append a short rollback section and a user-visible note for performance impact. Suggest edit in draft: `docs/release_notes/2026-03-21-quant-v5.2.1.md` - add "Known issue: small-batch eviction spike under certain KV-cache patterns; workaround: pin older runtime or reduce batch size." 
chris: I'll PR the note. Also adding rollback criteria: > 2% sustained eviction for >15m OR >0.5% error-rate increase.
sandeep: For telemetry, add alert: quant.eviction.rate slice=t-22 > 2% for 15m -> page oncall.
amy: Ops: If we want a quick hotfix build, I can trigger a matmul microbuild (quant-ls) today; but prefer to validate with a repro first. Anyone has a repro prompt?
chris: Not yet. Can we run a microbench on a staging slice with the same sequence length distribution? I'll kick that off.
ops-bot: Scheduled staging microbench job job-8791. ETA 12m.
amy: Thanks. For the release note edit, PR link when ready and I'll approve. Also adding a temporary release note header: "EMERGENCY: roll pause for t-22" so account teams see it.
chris: PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/412 - added rollback criteria and mitigation steps. @amy please approve.
amy: Approved. I'll update the incident channel if we decide to unpin or roll back. For now keep pin and no traffic to slice t-22.
luis: Agreed. Re-evaluate at 08:00Z or earlier if microbench shows regression fix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
